notes: In-residual driven single-pendulum dynamics check: each Gauss6 stage solves a square residual containing theta collocation, ASME driven velocity/acceleration rows, translational dynamics, rotational dynamics, pivot reactions, axis multipliers, and the drive multiplier. The DP1 drive-position residual is reported as a diagnostic. The ASME pivot/axis geometry is embedded in the scalar theta coordinate, so this is a driven FullVA residual bridge rather than the final general absolute-coordinate four-example implementation.
